scripts.build:windows: pnpm run build:win-x64 && pnpm run build:win-arm64
scripts.build:windows-linux: pnpm run build:win-x64-linux && pnpm run build:win-arm64-linux
scripts.build:win-x64: set "CGO_ENABLED=1" && set "GOFLAGS=-trimpath" && set "GOMAXPROCS=8" && set "ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR=%CD%\.zig-cache" && set "ZIG_LOCAL_CACHE_DIR=%CD%\.zig-cache" && set "GOOS=windows" && set "GOARCH=amd64" && set "CC=zig cc -target x86_64-windows-gnu" && go build -buildmode=c-shared -ldflags="-s -w -buildid= -extldflags '-static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ -Wl,-Bstatic -lpthread -Wl,-Bdynamic'" -o ./binaries/core-win-x64.node .

scripts.build:macos-intel: set "CGO_ENABLED=1" && set "GOFLAGS=-trimpath" && set "GOMAXPROCS=8" && set "ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR=%CD%\.zig-cache" && set "ZIG_LOCAL_CACHE_DIR=%CD%\.zig-cache" && set "GOOS=darwin" && set "GOARCH=amd64" && set "CC=zig cc -target x86_64-macos --sysroot %CD%\MacOSX11.3.sdk -isysroot %CD%\MacOSX11.3.sdk -L/usr/lib -F %CD%\MacOSX11.3.sdk\System\Library\Frameworks" && go build -tags "netgo,osusergo" -buildmode=c-shared -ldflags="-s -w -buildid= -extldflags '-undefined dynamic_lookup'" -o ./binaries/core-darwin-x64.node .
